notes: A1: the pictures are of a headless page, so no address bar (and no link or token) is in them.

A1: a non-browser client (Accept: application/json, or */*) asking for the CANCELLED link is answered 200 with the simulator's own page ("This payment is cancelled.", no Pay button) while the api still holds that page in memory, as it was before the change; a made-up id is answered 404 with the JSON error {error:{code:"NOT_FOUND",message:"No such payment page"}} as before.

A2: 400 ms after the refusal the panel still read "Deposit requested" with the refusal line (its own re-read was in flight); by 1.2 s it read "Request closed · ฿2,000", with no page load and no navigation.
A3: the chat panel above the summary reads "Deposit paid · ฿3,000" with its own Paid badge (the chat request's state); the Financial Summary itself carries DEPOSIT HELD and no PAID / Overpaid.
